post.title: One bad week erased the Nasdaq's entire 2026 gain
post.ig:
One bad week just erased the Nasdaq's entire 2026 gain.
The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.28% on Friday, Nov 20, to 22,617.73, ending the week down 10%, its worst week since March 2020.
It's now down about 2.7% for 2026, after being up nearly 19% at its Oct 6 record close.
Reports say AI and chip stocks led the slide.
The broader S&P 500 fell 8.6% this week but is still up about 0.9% for the year (our math).
Sources: AP, CNN, CNBC.
